header.description: Your daily work, financial overview, and shortcuts.

metricContext.noAccountingPeriod: Business date {date} precedes the first accounting period {period} — configure a covering period in Close Setup
metricContext.runwayWeeks: {weeks, plural, one {# week of runway} other {# weeks of runway}}

catalog.operatingExpenses: Month-to-date operating expenses, excluding cost of sales, from the profit and loss report.
catalog.activeAccounts: Active accounts in the chart of accounts.
catalog.ledgerBalance: Net of all journal lines; balanced books should be zero.
catalog.recentEntries: The five most recently posted journal entries.
catalog.pendingApprovalsList: The newest approval requests awaiting a decision.
catalog.inProgress: Your draft bills, invoices, and journal entries.
catalog.myApprovals: Approval requests assigned to your role.
catalog.quickActions: Shortcuts for your most common tasks.
catalog.cashBalance: Posted balance of bank accounts in base currency.
catalog.openReceivables: Unpaid customer invoices in base currency.
catalog.overdueReceivables: Customer invoices past their due date in base currency.
catalog.openPayables: Unpaid vendor bills in base currency.
catalog.overduePayables: Vendor bills past their due date in base currency.
catalog.itemsToReconcile: Unmatched bank statement lines awaiting reconciliation.
catalog.closeReadiness: Latest period-close runs and their current stage.
catalog.agentFindings: Open background-agent findings — jump to the workbench.
catalog.revenue: Revenue posted month to date, in base currency.
catalog.netIncome: Revenue minus cost and expenses, month to date.
catalog.grossMargin: Gross profit and margin, month to date.
catalog.expectedReceipts: Predicted customer receipts in the next 30 days, in base currency.
catalog.expectedPayments: Predicted vendor payments in the next 30 days, in base currency.
catalog.topCustomers: Largest open customer balances, top five.
catalog.topVendors: Largest open vendor balances, top five.
catalog.runway: Projected cash and runway over the coming weeks, in base currency.
catalog.inboxList: Your top tasks with a link to the inbox.
catalog.payTile: Next pay date and last payslip.
catalog.balanceTile: Time-off balances with a request link.
catalog.ratiosProfitability: Margins and returns graded against your targets, for the period Financial Health opens on.
catalog.ratiosLiquidity: Current ratio, quick ratio and working capital at period end.
catalog.ratiosSolvency: Debt to equity, liabilities to equity and interest coverage, from the accounts you classify.
catalog.ratiosEfficiency: Asset turnover and productivity per employee, annualized for part-year periods.
catalog.ratiosOperating: Cost of sales and operating expense ratios, operating leverage and the Rule of 40.
catalog.ratioCurrent: Current ratio from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioQuick: Quick ratio from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.workingCapital: Working capital from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioDebtEquity: Debt to equity from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioInterestCoverage: Interest coverage from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioRoe: Return on equity from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioRoic: Return on invested capital from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioOperatingMargin: Operating margin from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.ratioNetMargin: Net margin from Financial Health, with its grade against your target.
catalog.healthScore: The overall health score and each category’s score, from your graded ratios.
catalog.healthInsights: Issues, recommendations and anomalies Financial Health found for the period.
catalog.revenueTrend: Monthly revenue, gross profit and operating income for the trailing months.
catalog.marginTrend: Monthly gross and operating margins for the trailing months.
catalog.budgetVariance: The approved budget against actuals for the period, with the accounts off track.
